children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Build a pinned, reviewable release with explicit security, storage, database, access, backup, and telemetry choices.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Archive the exact chart, image digests, values, and rendered manifests accepted for each environment.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Pin every artifact and make environment ownership explicit before the first workload reaches the cluster.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Pin the OCI chart and images to an approved version or digest.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Define namespace, RBAC, security contexts, networks, resources, and placement.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Set external URL, auth, database, storage, backups, telemetry, and updates.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Treat rendered manifests as the production change set, with Secrets kept outside committed values.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Start from chart defaults and schema; maintain an environment values file.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Run lint and template against the target Kubernetes version.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Review CRDs, RBAC, Services, Ingress, PVCs, jobs, and outbound access.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use an atomic, waited install, then accept the release only after control-plane and workload smoke tests.
